description.summary: Building India’s most powerful custom SLMs and real-time Speech-to-Speech voice agents that already handle millions of calls across banking, healthcare, and new economy brands.
description.about: We want to take our platform at even crazier scale. We are building things that real people use. Come deploy models you’re proud of.
responsibilities: Architect infrastructure for custom SLMs and real-time Speech-to-Speech voice agents
Build and scale custom diffusion-based audio models (cutting-edge, not just huggingface copy-paste)
Optimize inference until it can handle 10,000+ requests per second
Deploy models using TorchScript, ONNX, TensorRT, and DeepSpeed
Wrestle with GPUs and squeeze every millisecond out of the pipeline
requirements: Experience building or contributing to diffusion-based audio models
Deep expertise in PyTorch (it should be your second language)
War stories deploying models to production (TorchScript/ONNX/TensorRT)
Experience optimizing inference for massive scale (10,000+ RPS)
Ability to squeeze every millisecond out of a pipeline
benefits: ₹70 lakh cash + significant ESOPs (skin in the game)
Ownership over models that touch real people, not just “demo” users
Work with a smart, hungry, no-BS team

description.summary: Join as a Founding Full-stack Engineer with strong expertise in Backend and AI. OutFlo AI is an early-stage startup building an AI-first B2B outreach platform for GTM teams in the US. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants to build from scratch.
description.about: OutFlo AI helps GTM teams run LinkedIn outreach on auto-pilot. Founded by Tushar Singla (IIT Kharagpur), we are angel-backed by top global SaaS founders. Our vision is to be the AI-native sales enablement platform, powering every step of the GTM motion.
responsibilities: Lead the overall design architecture, development, and deployment of scalable solutions
Build AI-native product experiences using LLMs, Agents, RAG, and vector DBs
Drive best practices for software development, including code reviews and testing
Collaborate directly with the founder and customers to shape product direction
Ship code yourself while managing a small engineering team
Solve complex technical problems in a fast-paced environment
requirements: 2+ years experience in early-stage startups (pre-seed/seed) building end-to-end products
Hands-on expertise with Typescript, Node.js, Postgres, Express, React, AWS
Experience building AI-native products using LLMs and agentic frameworks
Strong understanding of backend architecture (microservices, queuing, scaling)
Willingness to work 6 days a week from Koramangala office (high intensity)
Comfort with ambiguity and a desire for climbing uphill battles
benefits: Front-row seat at a fast-growing AI SaaS company
High-impact role with clear path to CTO
Shape the product, culture, and technical roadmap
Work with a lean, ambitious team solving real problems
